cat > models/core/fct_arrivals__malaysia_summary.sql << 'EOF'
with base_airports as (

    select * from {{ ref('base_airports') }}

),

base_arrivals as (

    select * from {{ ref('base_arrivals__malaysia') }}

),

latest_arrivals as (

    select *
    from base_arrivals
    where arrival_date = (select max(arrival_date) from base_arrivals)
    and (is_code_share = false or is_code_share is null)

),

arrival_counts as (

    select
        arrival_iata,
        count(*) as flight_count
    from latest_arrivals
    group by arrival_iata

),

malaysia_airports as (

    select
        airport_id,
        name,
        iata,
        latitude,
        longitude
    from base_airports
    where country = 'Malaysia'

),

final as (

    select
        a.airport_id,
        a.name,
        a.latitude,
        a.longitude,
        coalesce(c.flight_count, 0) as flight_count
    from malaysia_airports a
    left join arrival_counts c
        on a.iata = c.arrival_iata
    order by flight_count desc

)

select * from final
EOF
